name: Extreme heat
summary: No heatwave warning across a major region found on 24 Nov; Queensland's severe heatwave ended on 19 Nov
state: Far North Queensland's severe heatwave warning ran to 19 Nov, with Weipa above 36°C for 41 straight days (The Watchers, 16 Nov). Chile's extreme heat alert for inland Atacama and Coquimbo ran only from 10 to 12 Nov (Latin Times). Searches on 24 Nov found no current heatwave warning across a major region, no new national record and no deadly heatwave, so Normal holds.
for_you: No major heatwave is under way. Southern-hemisphere summer and the strong El Niño raise the odds of heat in Australia, southern Africa and South America in the coming weeks; follow national weather service warnings if travelling.
rubric_hit: Normal: no heatwave warnings across a major region and no deadly heatwave found on 24 Nov

sources.title: The Watchers — Weipa hits 41 straight days above 36°C as severe heatwave grips Far North Queensland through November 19

why: Heat is the deadliest weather hazard globally, straining power grids, crops and health systems.
drivers: Heat domes, climate warming, season, humidity, urban heat islands.

rubric.alert: Deadly heatwave with top-tier official warnings across a large population.
rubric.watch: Heatwave warnings across a major region, or national temperature records.
rubric.normal: No major heatwaves affecting large populations.
